tree: per-tool module split landed (uncommitted working tree at audit time)
method: charter §6: warm, 5 measured runs after 2 warm-up calls; p50/p95 are nearest-rank over the 5 runs. Default arguments only ({symbol}). BB_NO_AUTO_REFRESH=1 on every measurement.

environment.host: linux x64, node v22.22.1, bun 1.3.14, tsx via npx
environment.runtime: source tree via npx tsx (no dist build in the measurement path)
environment.note: The machine was running the fleet during both tiers. T0/T1 are fixture-sized and stay far inside budget; T2's controls prove the reference-index numbers are algorithm-bound, not machine-bound (see t2Analysis.controls).

tiers.subject: workspace reference large index (.bb-data, 11,440 files, ~3.4 GB)
tiers.verdict: VIOLATED — blocked on the shared graph-engine query form (defect D1 in AUDIT.md)
tiers.whyNoP50P95: A 5-run warm measurement cannot be completed inside the tier's own 5 s budget: one default call takes 13.7–359.5 s depending on the symbol. Per-call observations and the controls/query-plan evidence below replace a p50/p95 that would only measure the fleet's I/O contention.

perCallObservations.truncationReason: traversal: caller-site-limit+caller-budget-exhausted (count: time-budget-exhausted — this answer is not reproducible)

engineQueryForms.label: flat target_symbol_id IN (list) form
engineQueryForms.plan: SEARCH r USING INDEX brain_rel_proj_type_target_idx (project_id=? AND relationship_type=? AND target_symbol_id=?)

engineQueryForms.label: engine's owner-cascade JOIN (…UNION ALL…) form
engineQueryForms.plan: SEARCH r USING INDEX brain_rel_proj_type_idx (project_id=? AND relationship_type=?) — scans every stored relationship row for the four dependency kinds, with a BLOOM FILTER probe on casc and a TEMP B-TREE for ORDER BY

t2Analysis.ratio: 830x between the two forms of the same question (12.5 ms vs 10 351 ms)
t2Analysis.conclusion: The reference-index cost is the graph engine's caller query, not this tool's freshness/aggregation layer and not only fleet load. T2 budget cannot be met until src/intelligence/graph/graph-engine.ts uses the target-indexed form (or an equivalent that keeps the matched-member identity).

regressionBaseline.preCampaignFigures: docs/tools/bb_impact.md (curated) records lane-corpus hub p50 441 ms / p95 1 411 ms / max 1 580 ms on a quiet machine, and a 1.30x cost against a control symbol for the constant/enum_member roots.
regressionBaseline.campaignBaseline: T0 p95 100.8 ms and T1 p95 243.5 ms are the fixture-tier baselines to hold; T2 has no valid baseline on this machine until the shared engine query is fixed.

blockedLegs.leg: T2 budget verdict as a product metric
blockedLegs.reason: Default-argument calls take 13.7–359.5 s on the reference index because of the shared graph engine's caller query (830x slower than the target-indexed equivalent); calls exceed both the 5 s budget and the 30 s client timeout. Blocked on the graph-engine owner's fix or a Lead decision; measurements above are the evidence, not a claim.
